implementationMessage: The leaked YouTube API key has been revoked. The GitHub repository no longer contains an obvious hard-coded Google API key and its CI validation passes. The current OshiLive 3.0 production workflow is ChatGPT Sites, but this legacy OshiLive-2.0 repository has not been verified as the exact source of the live Sites deployment. Configure YOUTUBE_API_KEY in the ChatGPT Site's owner-only Secrets settings, then validate the YouTube API flows on the Site.
safetyMessage: REVIEW: credential leakage is remediated, but final SAFE approval is pending two pieces of evidence: (1) YOUTUBE_API_KEY is configured in the OshiLive 3.0 ChatGPT Site Secrets, and (2) live-status, upcoming-streams, and channel-by-url are validated on the actual deployed Site. GitHub CI alone does not prove the current Sites deployment is healthy because the repository-to-Site source mapping is not yet verified.
